senses.gloss:
उद्द्युत् उद्-द्युत्, cl. 1. A. -द्योतते, -तितुम्,
to blaze up, shine: Caus. -द्योतयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to shine: Intens. Ved. -दविद्युतीति, to shine
intensely.

उद्-द्योत, अस्, आ, अम्, flashing up, shining; (अस्),
m. light, lustre; revelation.
उद्-द्योतित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted up, emblazoned.
उद्य उद्य, अस्, m. a river; [cf. उद्ध्य.]

उद्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वद्), to be spoken,
(उद्य, ‘a river,’ is incorrect for उद्ध्य.)

उद्या उद्-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -तुम्, to go up
or out, to rise, originate.

उद्यत् उद्-यत्, अन्, अती, अत् (fr. उद्-इ, q. v.),
rising; (अन्), m. a star; N. of a mountain.

उद्यम् उद्-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्,
to raise, elevate, uplift, raise in a menacing manner;
[]
to offer; to strive, be diligent; Intens. Ved. -यम्य-
मीति, to raise.

उद्-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, held up; active, per-
severing, labouring diligently and incessantly; trained,
exercised, disciplined; eager, prepared, ready; (अस्),
m. time (in music); a section, a chapter, the division
of a book.
—उद्यत-कार्मुक, अस्, आ, अम्, with raised
bow.
—उद्यत-गद, अस्, आ, अम्, with uplifted mace.
—उद्यत-शूल, अस्, आ, अम्, with raised spear.
—उद्-
यत-स्रुच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. raising the ladle to offer a
libation.
—उद्यतायुध (˚त-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, with
uplifted weapon or weapons.
उद्-यति, इस्, f., Ved. raising, elevation.
उद्-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, raising, elevating.

उद्-यम, अस्, m. raising or lifting up, elevation;
raising the hands for work, undertaking anything;
strenuous and continued effort, exertion, perseverance.
—उद्यम-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breaking the efforts,
discouragement, dissuasion; desisting.
—उद्यम-
भृत्, त्, त्, त्, bearing or undergoing exertions.

उद्-याम, अस्, m. erecting, stretching out; a rope,
cord.
उद्-यमन, अम्, n. raising, elevation.

उद्-यमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, undertaking, persevering, mak-
ing effort, active.

उद्-यमीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. extending more
widely; (Sāy.) excessively raising.
1. उद्-यम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, requiring exertion.

2. उद्-यम्य, ind. having lifted or taken up, hav-
ing made exertion.

उद्-यान, अम्, n. going out; walking out; a gar-
den, a royal garden, a park; purpose, motive; N. of
a country to the north of India.
—उद्यान-पाल, अस्,
m. a gardener; the master or owner or keeper of a
garden.
—उद्यान-पालक, अस्, इका, m. f. a gardener;
superintendent or keeper of a garden.
—उद्यान-रक्-
षक, अस्, m. a keeper of a garden; a gardener.
उद्यानक, अम्, n. a garden, a park.

उद्-यापन, अम्, n. bringing to a conclusion, finish-
ing, performing, accomplishing.

उद्-यापित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought to a conclusion,
finished, accomplished.

उद्याव उद्-याव, अस्, m. (rt. 1. यु), mixing,
joining.

उद्यास उद्-यास, अस्, m. (rt. यस्), Ved. exer-
tion, effort.

उद्युज् उद्-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते,
-योक्तुम्, to excite, incite, make active or quick,
stimulate to exertion.

उद्-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, zealously active, labouring
for some desired end.

उद्-योग, अस्, m. undertaking anything, exertion,
perseverance, strenuous and continuous endeavour;
active preparation.
—उद्योग-पर्वन्, अ, n. title of
the fifth book of the Mahā-bhārata.
—उद्योग-स-
मर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, capable of exertion.

उद्-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, active, laborious, persevering,
energetic, one who makes effort.
उद्-यमित, अस्, आ, अम्, excited, instigated.
